description: Datasheet-derived stand-in for a flanged SC/APC simplex fiber adapter/coupler (the green plastic panel-mount type). Dimensions from the FS.com AD-SCA-SCA-SM-SX-FS datasheet drawing (datasheets/). This is a PURCHASED part — the model exists for fit checks, corridor/keep-out reasoning, and assembly renders, not fabrication. Replace the exported STEP with a true vendor CAD file if one is ever obtained (GrabCAD/TraceParts host some behind free accounts).
material: vendor part (plastic, UL 94V-0), ceramic split sleeve
frame: X = flange long axis, Y = mating axis, Z = short axis. Origin at the body/flange center (flange is centered along the body length).
notes: Simplified: the stainless snap-in clips and internal keying/shutter details are omitted; outer body is a plain rectangular tube. The envelope, flange, screw holes, and ceramic split sleeve are dimensionally per the datasheet drawing.
Datasheet tolerances (e.g. 27.4 +/-0.3) are modeled at nominal.
Used by parts/custom/oz510-dual-housing/fit_check.py to verify the housing's back-panel port: the adapter body must pass the wall cutout and the flange must seat on the outer face.
